steps.title: Enable IP Control on your Samsung TV
steps.body: On your Samsung TV go to Settings → General → External Device Manager → Device Connect Manager → Access Notification and set it to First Time Only or Always Allow.

steps.title: Connect iPhone and TV to the same Wi-Fi
steps.body: Make sure your iPhone and Samsung TV are connected to the same home Wi-Fi network. This is required for Wi-Fi remote control.

steps.title: Open Universal TV Remote and tap Add TV
steps.body: Launch the Universal TV Remote app on your iPhone, tap the + button at the top right, then select Samsung from the brand list.

steps.title: Auto-detect your Samsung TV
steps.body: The app will scan your network and display your TV. Tap it to connect. If not found, tap Enter IP Manually and input the IP shown under Settings → General → Network → Network Status on your TV.

steps.title: Accept the pairing request on your TV
steps.body: Your Samsung TV will show a pairing prompt. Select Allow to complete the connection.

steps.title: Start controlling your TV
steps.body: The Samsung remote layout will appear in the app. You can now control power, volume, channels, Smart Hub, and launch apps directly from your iPhone.

steps.title: Enable LG Mobile TV On
steps.body: On your LG TV go to Settings → All Settings → General → Mobile TV On and turn it on. This allows the TV to be controlled even from standby.

steps.title: Connect both devices to the same network
steps.body: Ensure your iPhone and LG TV share the same Wi-Fi network.

steps.title: Open Universal TV Remote and add your LG TV
steps.body: In the app, tap +, select LG, and let the app auto-detect your WebOS TV.

steps.title: Authorize the connection on your TV
steps.body: A prompt will appear on your LG TV asking to allow remote access. Select Accept.

steps.title: Use Magic Remote features
steps.body: The app replicates LG Magic Remote functions including pointer mode, gesture control, and quick access to LG content store.

steps.title: Enable Remote Start on Sony TV
steps.body: Go to Settings → Network → Remote Start and turn it On. This allows the app to wake your Sony TV from standby.

steps.title: Enable IP control
steps.body: Go to Settings → Network → IP Control and set Authentication to Normal and Pre-Shared Key. Note the IP from Settings → Network → Network Setup → View Network Status.

steps.title: Add your Sony TV in the app
steps.body: Open Universal TV Remote, tap +, select Sony, and let it auto-discover your TV on the network.

steps.title: Enter the pre-shared key if prompted
steps.body: If your Sony TV requires a pre-shared key, enter the key you set in the IP Control settings (default is usually empty or 0000).

steps.title: Control Google TV or Android TV features
steps.body: Once connected, you have full access to Google Assistant commands, app launcher, and Google TV home screen navigation.

steps.title: Find your TCL Roku TV on the network
steps.body: On your TCL Roku TV press the Home button, go to Settings → System → About to see the device name and network info.

steps.title: Enable Roku external control
steps.body: Go to Settings → System → Advanced System Settings → External Control and enable Network Access.

steps.title: Connect iPhone to the same Wi-Fi
steps.body: Make sure your iPhone is on the same Wi-Fi network as the TCL TV.

steps.title: Add TCL TV in Universal TV Remote
steps.body: Open the app, tap +, select TCL (Roku TV), and the app will find your TV automatically.

steps.title: Control Roku interface
steps.body: You now have full Roku interface control including the home screen, search, voice search, and direct app launch from your iPhone.

steps.title: Enable VIDAA Remote Service
steps.body: On your Hisense TV go to Settings → Support → Mobile Device Connection and turn on the remote service.

steps.title: Note the TV IP address
steps.body: Go to Settings → Network → Network Status to find your TV IP address.

steps.title: Add Hisense TV in the app
steps.body: Open Universal TV Remote, tap +, select Hisense, and let the app scan your network.

steps.title: Pair and connect
steps.body: The app will find your VIDAA Smart TV. Tap it to pair and connect in seconds.

steps.title: Enjoy full control
steps.body: Control VIDAA platform navigation, adjust gaming mode settings, and launch streaming apps directly from your iPhone.

steps.title: Enable Roku external control protocol
steps.body: On your Roku device press Home, go to Settings → System → Advanced System Settings → External Control → Network Access and set to Default or Permissive.

steps.title: Connect to the same Wi-Fi
steps.body: Your iPhone must be on the same Wi-Fi as your Roku TV or stick.

steps.title: Add Roku in Universal TV Remote
steps.body: Tap +, select Roku, and the app auto-discovers your device instantly.

steps.title: Control and launch channels
steps.body: Use the Roku directional pad, launch any channel by name, and use the built-in keyboard for faster text input than the on-screen keyboard.
